title: Story premise EDU062: The Keys Arrive Before the Search
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (home organization). Hook: Where did the keys go before you needed them? Takeaway/theme: Put an item’s return point where the relevant routine actually happens.
description: A housemate wants to leave on time, but keys land in a different place after every arrival. A small landing tray at the actual entry route creates a repeatable return path and ends the fictional search loop.
